veranderings.voor: Die doel van die sang is
veranderings.rede: Avoids the clumsy 'die sang ... saam te sing' repetition; the block is already about the singing, and the maskandi block uses the same short form 'Die doel is'.

veranderings.voor: maklik is om saam te dra
veranderings.na: maklik is om rond te dra
veranderings.rede: 'Saam te dra' can be read by a learner as 'carry together'; 'rond te dra' is the natural way to say an instrument is portable.

veranderings.voor: wat 'n kontras met die sang daarna vorm
veranderings.na: wat 'n kontras vorm met die sang daarna
veranderings.rede: Moving the verb before the prepositional phrase avoids the awkward 'daarna vorm' cluster at the end of the relative clause.
